thread:
lucas-support: Incoming customer escalation — multiple clients reporting intermittent 5xx and timeouts hitting hosted-infer gateway since ~22:10 UTC. One customer says ~3% of requests returned 502/504 and a few timeouts. Raising to oncall.

maria-ops: got the SLO burn alert now :rotating_light: — probe SLO spiked p99 latency for inference-gateway-prod in eu-west-1. Datadog shows p99 > 3s for the last 6m.

sre-bot: Alert: SLO_GATEWAY_P99 > 2.0s (6m window). Severity: P2. AlertID: A-20260317-2310

ajay-sre: checking dashboards. grafana -> gateway-overview shows 5xx fraction up from 0.2% -> 2.9% at 22:09. Need logs + traces. Can someone run a quick logs query and check trace coverage? Suggested logs query: `env:prod service:inference-gateway status:[500 TO 599] | count by (status, upstream)`

devon-runtime: running log query now in LogQL: `sum by (status, upstream) (rate({app="inference-gateway",env="prod"} |= "5" [5m]))` — initial result: burst concentrated on upstream cluster `prefetch-batcher-v2` and a small portion on `kv-cache`. Also seeing increased `handshake timeout` messages in gateway logs.

maria-ops: traces look sparse. trace sampling decreased for this path (weird). Datadog trace coverage for gateway->batcher is 12% during spike vs 42% baseline. Possible trace-gap.

ajay-sre: could be batched backend overload causing timeouts that manifest as 504. Check batcher backlog: `curl -s http://batcher-metrics.prod:9090/metrics | grep backlog` — any numbers?

devon-runtime: backlog spiked to ~1800 requests queued on a subset of pods, CPU at 95% on those 3 pods. One pod OOM-killed and restarted around 22:08 (kube events show restartCount 1). Logs show bump in `kv cache thrashed` warnings right before OOM.

lucas-support: customer reports retries escalated error rate because their client retries without jitter. They see cascading failures. I pushed heads-up to customer and created ticket INC-79312.

ajay-sre: mitigation plan: 1) scale batcher pool + increase replica count in eu-west-1 by +3, 2) toggle conservative batching config to lower max-batch-size for tail latency, 3) enable temporary traffic-shift to fallback model variant (lighter quant) for the affected route. I'll open rollout. Anyone want to own the scale step?

maria-ops: I'll handle horizontal scale and k8s drain of the suspect pod set. On it.

devon-runtime: I pushed batcher config change to reduce `max_batch_size` from 256->64 for the suspect deployment and lowered batch latency threshold to 50ms. Also bumped probe success threshold to avoid fast restarts. Monitoring now.

datadog-bot: Event: infra action executed — scaled deployment batcher-v2 +3 replicas at 22:17 UTC. Metric watch: backlog decreasing.

ajay-sre: backlog trending down, p99 improving. Trace coverage still low, need to investigate why spans are being dropped — suspect instrumentation rate limiter on high-throughput pods. I'll correlate agent logs and sampling config.

maria-ops: customer updated: observed lower error rate after 22:25, they see requests succeeding. Keeping customer updated and moving ticket to on-hold until we confirm stability.

lucas-support: thanks team. Please drop the final RCA steps and signal when we can close the customer ticket.

ajay-sre: quick follow-ups for RCA: collect pod crash logs for OOM candidate, upload batcher metrics (backlog, cpu, gc pause) for 30m window, verify sampling agent config (env var TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE) and whether it changed at deploy. I'll open a follow-up thread with collected queries and links.

devon-runtime: saved logs at `s3://redwood-ops/incident/5172467890/` — included `kube-events.log`, `batcher-stats.json`, `gateway-5xx-snippets.log`. Will attach to INC-79312.

sre-bot: Incident summary (temp): Gateway 5xx spike + p99 latency from 22:08-22:32 UTC impacting hosted-infer eu-west-1. Root cause: batcher pod OOM + backlog + trace sampling drop. Mitigation: scaled batcher, reduced max batch size, rolled config. Next: RCA doc + vendor/billing impact check.

lucas-support: I logged the mitigation notes into the customer ticket and set expectation for RCA by EOD tomorrow. Closing chat unless new regressions appear.

maria-ops: confirming stable for last 15m, no SLO alerts firing. Will remain on-watch for 1 hour.

ajay-sre: thx. Follow-up: add alert on trace_coverage < 30% for 5xx windows to detect trace gaps earlier. Filing monitoring task.
